label: HTTP route
description: A route. The body is decoded by the consumes codec into request.body (typed by settings.body); query, route placeholders (request.params, each one required), headers and cookies are in the context too, and the guarding plugin adds the caller it identified (request.principal, request.session, request.challenge) for triggers whose policy attachments give it a credential. The trigger's input mapping picks what the graph gets; the trigger's policies decide before the graph runs; the answer is encoded by the produces codec with the status the response block chooses, and sets the cookies response.cookies takes from it. A refusal (a graph ending on purpose with a reason, a policy denying, the guard refusing a credential) is answered as { reason, message } plus what it carries, with the status response.refusals maps that reason to; every reason the route can reach must be mapped (T005). A fault (a node that broke and no switch caught, or a run blocked on a root nothing supplied) is answered 500 { error: 'fault', run } with the run's id and nothing of what broke; the log and the trace say that. A run past its deadline (deadlineMs) is cancelled and answered 504, and a body past its bound (maxBodyBytes) is answered 413; either is the route's own setting, else the plugin's.

route.description: e.g. /tasks or /tasks/{id}; each {name} is a required request.params.name

consumes.description: the body's content type; must be in the plugin's codecs table

produces.description: the answer's content type; must be in the codecs table. Default application/json

body.description: the edge type of the decoded body (request.body); declaring it means a body is expected, so a request without one is a 400. Absent: the body is the trigger's in

deadlineMs.description: the most this route's run may take, in milliseconds, from firing to answer; past it the run is cancelled and answered 504. Absent: the plugin's setting, else none

maxBodyBytes.description: the most a body may weigh; past it the request is answered 413 before the codec finishes. Absent: the plugin's setting, else none

from.description: a path into the answer whose value picks the status

status.description: the status of an answer: from a path into it through map, else default (200)

refusals.description: reason -> status: how each refusal the route can reach is answered, e.g. { "missing": 404, "upstream": 502 }. The body is { reason, message }. A reason this table does not map is answered as a fault, and the log names the reason; T005 makes it unreachable except across a reload.

cookies.description: cookie name -> what it takes from the answer and how it is set: { "session": { "from": "accessToken", "omit": true, "httpOnly": true, "maxAge": 900 } }

response.description: how the route answers: the status of an answer, one status per refusal reason, and the cookies it sets

headers.description: lower-cased names; secret, since a credential rides here (authorization, an api key, the cookie header): the run reads the values, and every report and trace shows the map as the marker

cookies.description: the request's cookies by name, from the cookie header; secret, since a session cookie is a bearer token

params.description: the route's placeholders, each a string the route guarantees
